City — Zurich, Switzerland

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Central business district including Zürich HB, the main train station. Very safe during the day; normal transit-hub caution at night, and nearby Platzspitz Park (site of a former open drug scene) is best avoided after dark.

This is a limited-data assessment. Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset, and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and is labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.
Real official data point: City sits in Kreis 1, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 38.8 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 379% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for City specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.

Frequently asked questions

Is City safe?

Wandroz currently rates City in Zurich as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is City safe at night?

At night, City is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is City a good area to stay in as a tourist?

City's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there any official crime data for City?

Partially. City sits in Kreis 1, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich publishes a real, current burglary rate for that district — 38.8 per 1,000 residents. Kreis 1 has about 5,583 residents, under a third of the median Zurich district. Burglary counts include break-ins at shops, offices and hotels, so dividing them by a resident population this small measures how commercial the district is, not how risky it is for a person. The figure is shown; it is not ranked against the other districts.. This covers burglaries only, not all crime types, and is reported at district level, not specifically for City — see the box below for the full figure and caveats.
